title: artemisia leucophylla var. rotundatiloba
intro: Artemisia leucophylla var. rotundatiloba, commonly known as mountain silver sage, is a shrubby perennial plant native to the southwestern United States. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Artemisia leucophylla var. rotundatiloba include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory problems, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
